name: S Night Paparazzi Flash
description: Relight this image. Change nothing else except the lighting. Keep the existing background, setting and framing exactly as they are and add nothing to the scene — only the light falling on it changes. A single hard flash sits on the lens axis and fires straight at the subject from camera position at chest height, lighting the front of the body flat and evenly with almost no modelling across the face, so the shadow is thrown directly behind the subject and sits hard-edged and close behind them. Falloff is steep in the way a bare flash falls off: the subject sits a touch hot, speculars clip to white on anything glossy — satin, leather, metal, jewellery — and whatever already stands behind the subject drops several stops into near darkness. Whatever light already existed in the scene survives only as a dim warm cast far under the subject in exposure, reading orange against the neutral 5500K flash. Neutral flash against dim warm ambient, hard shadow directly behind the subject, steep falloff into deep blacks, clipped speculars on glossy surfaces, visible noise in the darker areas, realistic skin texture with pores intact. Keep the subject identity, pose, expression, hairstyle and clothing exactly as they are, and do not add, remove or replace any part of the setting.
